title: Sunroof opening and shade operation
summary: Feedback centers on sunroof appearance, requests for an opening sunroof, and complaints about shade or control operation, with many fragments too brief to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to liking the sunroof’s appearance.

negative.summary: Negative feedback cites dissatisfaction with manual blind operation and poorly working or poorly located sunroof shade controls.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the sunroof or shade not opening, desired opening capability, or remembered startup behavior without enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in interpreting the overall tone.
Several fragments are very short or ambiguous about whether they describe a defect, a feature request, or recalled prior behavior.
The topic mixes product preferences about having an opening sunroof with possible operational issues involving the sunroof or shade.
